llm_findings: The bounded plan defines one causal architecture change: zero-initialized per-channel gates adding encoder block outputs into decoder inputs in LIFO order. Toggle, optimizer registration, checkpoint persistence, and logging are supporting plumbing; existing block computations and training hyperparameters remain unchanged.

GPT.forward contains the specified block-loop insertion point. GPT.setup_optimizer explicitly collects parameter objects, and its gate_params group uses AdamW at MATRIX_LR with betas (0.9, 0.95) and zero weight decay. Explicitly extending gate_params addresses the reported r1 routing defect.

No matching closed encoder-to-decoder skip direction appears in the supplied decision log or source. Block.forward's embedding skip, frozen block nudge, and GPT.forward's final-output pooling are distinct mechanisms.

The change is competition-legal under README.md: train.py architecture edits are permitted, no pretrained weights or external training data are introduced, and the evaluator remains untouched. Same-position additions of causal block outputs preserve structural causality; ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES and state_dict persistence support consistent evaluation reconstruction.

The predicted BPB reduction and throughput range are falsifiable against the controller-pinned seed-42 full-chip matched control. Implementation preparation is static-only; executable correctness and performance checks are assigned to smoke rather than made prerequisites for implementation approval.

Interpretation caveats: DECISION_LOG.md records BF16 SDPA input as a KEEP at 2233 steps, so epoch crossing does not establish that throughput is exhausted. Zero initialization supports mathematical forward equivalence, not guaranteed compiled bitwise equality or near-identical trajectories after hundreds of updates. These stronger claims are not needed to justify this experiment.

Exact-patch review should account for source details: gate_params is separate from local_conv_params and is empty at the pinned defaults, so this introduces an active gate AdamW group rather than merely enlarging an active one. Optimizer coverage must exclude intentionally frozen qk_shift_beta parameters; comparison with all model parameters would falsely report missing coverage.
